Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，虽然可能会有点突然
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser… this might be a little sudden, but…

Content.SourceString: 要一起去找外星人吗<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Do you want to look for aliens together <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 还真是够突然的。
Content.LocalizedString: That really is pretty sudden.

Content.SourceString: 海特洛居然有外星人？！
Content.LocalizedString: Hethereau actually has aliens?!

Content.SourceString: 因为是刚刚突然找到的
Content.LocalizedString: Because I only just found it.

Content.SourceString: 没错<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: That's right <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 外星人的飞船<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: An alien spaceship <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 我找到了他们的飞船
Content.LocalizedString: I found their spaceship

Content.SourceString: 不过，为什么会来邀请我呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Why did you invite me?

Content.SourceString: 因为对鉴定师的电波有印象
Content.LocalizedString: Because the Appraiser's frequency left an impression on me.

Content.SourceString: 有一种，会对外星人感兴趣的感觉<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: I have a feeling that you'll be interested in aliens <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师要一起来吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Want to come along, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 来！<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Sure! <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 马上出发~
Content.LocalizedString: Heading out now~

Content.SourceString: 好耶<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Yay <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 好耶<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Yay <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，虽然可能会有点突然
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser… this might be a little sudden, but…

Content.SourceString: 你认识能修理闹鬼电视机的人吗<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Do you know anyone who can fix a haunted TV?<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>

OptionText.SourceString: 听着像是驱魔师的工作。
OptionText.LocalizedString: Sounds like a job for an exorcist.

OptionText.SourceString: 难道是灵可平时背着的那台？
OptionText.LocalizedString: Could it be the one Linko usually carries around?

Content.SourceString: 修理闹鬼的电视机……听着像是驱魔师的工作。
Content.LocalizedString: Fixing a haunted TV… Call an exorcist.

Content.SourceString: 闹鬼的电视……难道是灵可平时背着的那台？
Content.LocalizedString: The haunted TV… could it be the one Linko usually carries around?

Content.SourceString: 不可以！会把小贞驱散的<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>
Content.LocalizedString: No! It'll drive Xiaozhen away<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯，就是小贞的窝<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Yep, it's Xiaozhen's bed<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>

Content.SourceString: 原来是小贞住的那台吗！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, it's the one Xiaozhen lives in!

Content.SourceString: 昨天执行任务的时候，我不小心掉进了海里，回家之后发现电视打不开了……
Content.LocalizedString: Yesterday, while I was on a mission, I accidentally fell into the ocean. And, well, when I got home, the TV wouldn't turn on…

Content.SourceString: 掉进了海里？！你没受伤吧？
Content.LocalizedString: You fell into the sea?! Are you okay?

Content.SourceString: 电视打不开的话……那小贞怎么样了？
Content.LocalizedString: If the TV won't turn on… then what about Xiaozhen?

Content.SourceString: 我没有事，但自从电视坏掉之后，小贞就再没出现过了<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>
Content.LocalizedString: I'm fine, but ever since the TV broke, Xiaozhen hasn't shown up<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>

Content.SourceString: 我不知道，从那之后她一直没有出来<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>
Content.LocalizedString: I don't know. She hasn't come out since then<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>

Content.SourceString: 如果是确认小贞的情况，我倒是可以帮上忙。
Content.LocalizedString: If it's about Xiaozhen, I'll lend a hand.

Content.SourceString: 真的吗！谢谢鉴定师！
Content.LocalizedString: Really?! Thank you, Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 我们在旧电器店这边！
Content.LocalizedString: We're over by the old electronics store!

Content.SourceString: 我们在旧电器店这边！
Content.LocalizedString: We're over by the old electronics store!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，虽然可能会有点突然
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser… this might be a little sudden, but…

OptionText.LocalizedString: You always catch me off guard.

Content.SourceString: 每次都很突然呢
Content.LocalizedString: You always catch me off guard.

Content.SourceString: 灵可有什么事就直接说吧~
Content.LocalizedString: Linko, if there's anything on your mind, just say it~

Content.SourceString: 也是呢
Content.LocalizedString: I suppose

Content.SourceString: 我想给鉴定师介绍一个来自宇宙的朋友
Content.LocalizedString: I want to introduce you to a friend from outer space.

OptionText.SourceString: 我也想认识一下灵可的朋友
OptionText.LocalizedString: I'd like to meet Linko's friend too.

Content.SourceString: 这回真的有点突然了，居然是来自宇宙的朋友！
Content.LocalizedString: This really is kind of sudden—but it's a friend from outer space!

Content.SourceString: 好呀，我也想认识一下灵可的朋友。
Content.LocalizedString: Sure, I'd like to meet Linko's friend too.

Content.SourceString: 它的行程很赶，和我们见一面就会离开
Content.LocalizedString: Their schedule is pretty tight, so they'll have to leave right after an introduction.

Content.SourceString: 我们就在……那个离宇宙最近的地方见面吧<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Let's meet at… the place closest to the universe<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>

Content.SourceString: 一直以来谢谢你，鉴定师
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you for always being there, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 一直以来谢谢你，鉴定师
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you for always being there, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 这次任务真是太惊险了，还好能顺利解决！
Content.LocalizedString: The last mission was so dangerous! I'm glad it ended well!

Content.SourceString: 也辛苦灵可了，还好管理局的大家合作无间，伊南娜的阴谋才没有得逞。
Content.LocalizedString: Linko, you did great. Thanks to everyone in the Bureau, Inanna's plot was foiled.

Content.SourceString: 灵可在里面，和妮夏一起打败了一条超级异象大蛇
Content.LocalizedString: I did my part! Nitsa and I defeated a super huge snake anomaly!

Content.SourceString: 按理说，它由我们首次发现，应该是我们来起名字<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Usually, we have naming rights since we discovered it first <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 当时还打算给它起个很帅的名字来着，但实在是来不及了
Content.LocalizedString: I was going to give it a super cool name, but it's too late now.

Content.SourceString: 噢！还有个新发现！小贞居然害怕蛇！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, I found out something new! Xiaozhen is afraid of snakes!

Content.SourceString: 你们那边居然是这样的经历……
Content.LocalizedString: Can't believe you had to do that…

Content.SourceString: 如果是很大的蛇，那确实挺危险的……我见到我也怕。
Content.LocalizedString: Large snakes can be lethal… I'm sure it'll scare me too.

Content.SourceString: ……抛开危险的部分，其实还挺好玩的？让我想起以前玩过的游戏……是什么来着……
Content.LocalizedString: Danger aside… it was actually pretty fun? The fight reminded me of some game I played before… What's its name…

Content.SourceString: 不记得了，但总之挺有趣的！
Content.LocalizedString: I can't remember. Anyway, it was fun!

Content.SourceString: 能留下美好的记忆那也不错……
Content.LocalizedString: I'm glad you made some good memories…

Content.SourceString: 也有超级糟糕的回忆！在最后的仪式现场里，那个突然冒出来的家伙——
Content.LocalizedString: I also made some awful ones! The one that suddenly appeared in the final ritual…

Content.SourceString: 它的电波……很难去描述，像是锯片从钢管上刮过的声音，或者猫爪挠黑板的声音，或者说……
Content.LocalizedString: Its frequency… is hard to describe, like the sound of a saw blade scraping a steel pipe, or a pair of claws scratching down a chalkboard, or rather…

Content.SourceString: 呃唔……光是回忆都感觉很难受——总之就是真的超级超级难听！难听到我甚至想把所有频带都切断的程度！
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh… just thinking about it gives me a headache. Anyway, it was super annoying to listen to! I almost wanted to block out all frequencies!

Content.SourceString: 光看描述我也能感觉到难受……
Content.LocalizedString: I can tell how much you hated it…

Content.SourceString: 把它和鉴定师的电波放在一起，完全就是两个极端！
Content.LocalizedString: That one's frequency and yours are totally polar opposites!

Content.SourceString: 希望再也不用听到那家伙的电波了<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>
Content.LocalizedString: I hope I never need to listen to that frequency again <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003"/>

Content.SourceString: 我也希望如此……别再惹上那个麻烦了
Content.LocalizedString: I hope so too… May we never meet that one again…

Content.SourceString: 但不管怎么说，记录对象电波的特征也是我的工作，虽然真的很难听，我还是专门写了一份关于它的观察报告……
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, my job involves documenting frequency characteristics. As much as I hated its frequency, I still filed a report about it…

Content.SourceString: 说起来，我的记录本好像被局长收走了，到现在都没还给我
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, btw, I think the Director took in my notes. She hasn't returned them yet.

Content.SourceString: 噢！我还在上面画了大蛇的样子，还写了我起的名字，说不定是局长喜欢上了<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Oh! I even doodled the snake on my notes and left my signature! Maybe the Director likes it <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 但愿是这样把……也可能因为是大型任务，需要整理很久……
Content.LocalizedString: I hope that's true… or maybe she's buried in paperwork for a mission with such scale…

Content.SourceString: 不说这个了。灵可给大蛇起了什么名字？
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, what did you want to call the snake?

Content.SourceString: 「大力铁头蛇」<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: "Big Bonk Danger Noodle" <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 真是直白易懂的好名字，比管理局起的名字好懂多了。
Content.LocalizedString: What a straightforward name! I like it better than the Bureau's version.

Content.SourceString: 嘿嘿，谢谢鉴定师<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe, thanks <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 今天我找到了一个超级有趣的电波<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: I detected a super interesting frequency today! <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 我猜猜看，是来自异象？
Content.LocalizedString: Let me guess, it's from an anomaly?

Content.SourceString: 来源是什么？人？异象？
Content.LocalizedString: What's sending it? A person? An anomaly?

Content.SourceString: 是一个消防栓<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: It's from a fire hydrant <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 消防栓？那会是什么电波……
Content.LocalizedString: Fire hydrant? What kind of frequency is that…?

Content.SourceString: 它觉得自己的生活很无聊，每天都守在人行道上，被路过的人俯视，有时还会被当成无用的路障……
Content.LocalizedString: It thinks its life is sooo boring, stuck on the sidewalk all day, everybody looking down on it as they pass by, and sometimes people even treat it like some pointless object in the way…

Content.SourceString: 而且，它很羡慕街边服装店橱窗里的假人模特，因为它们总是被人们欣赏……它期待能有一场，只有它能熄灭的大火！
Content.LocalizedString: And it's super jealous of the mannequins in the clothing store windows down the street, because people always admire them… What it really wants is a huge fire, one that only it can put out!

Content.SourceString: 如果是真的，消防栓的心理状态有点危险……不会哪天变成异象吧……
Content.LocalizedString: If that's true, the mental state of the fire hydrant is a bit worrying… It might turn into an anomaly some day…

Content.SourceString: 消防栓这样的物品，居然也能有这么复杂的「电波」？我还以为只有人或者异象会有……
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't know something like a fire hydrant could send such a complicated frequency. I thought only people or anomalies do…

Content.SourceString: 有的哦，还有垃圾桶，红绿灯，甚至是路边的大石头，树下的蘑菇……
Content.LocalizedString: They do. The trash bin, the traffic lights, the stones near the road, and even the mushrooms under the tree…

Content.SourceString: 从它们旁边经过的时候，经常能接收到微弱的电波<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: I receive these weaker frequencies all the time whenever I pass by them <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 连物品都会发出电波的话……灵可会不会经常觉得很吵？
Content.LocalizedString: If inanimate objects can send frequencies… isn't it noisy?

Content.SourceString: 其实也不会……物品的电波一般都比较平稳，不会特别吵。
Content.LocalizedString: Not exactly… frequencies from inanimate objects tend to be consistent. They're not really noisy.

Content.SourceString: 就像是……每个物品都会反射光线、呈现自己的颜色……但我不会经常觉得，眼前的一切很刺眼。
Content.LocalizedString: It's like… every object reflects light and shows its colors… but I don't usually find them blinding.

Content.SourceString: 灵可的日常很有意思呢，仿佛有一种观察世界的新角度。
Content.LocalizedString: You have an interesting life. You always have fresh takes on the world.

Content.SourceString: 像随时收听着……完全未知的电台频道那样？
Content.LocalizedString: It's like you're always… listening for signals from unknown radio channels?

Content.SourceString: 噢！鉴定师居然能懂这种感觉……果然我们的电波是同频的<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Oh! Appraiser, you really get it… Our frequencies must be in sync <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 你平时睡觉之前，会听音乐吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you listen to music before you sleep?

Content.SourceString: 有时候会听一些放松身心的音乐。
Content.LocalizedString: Sometimes I listen to music that helps me relax.

Content.SourceString: 我比较喜欢完全安静的环境。
Content.LocalizedString: I usually prefer a totally quiet setting.

Content.SourceString: 我也是这么猜的<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: That's what I thought <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 原来是这样……如果是我的话，可能会有一点
Content.LocalizedString: I see… but if it were me, I might…

Content.SourceString: 灵可睡觉前，会听什么呢？
Content.LocalizedString: So what do you listen to before going to bed?

Content.SourceString: 嗯……什么都听一点<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… a bit of everything <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 比如一些鼓和吉他很大声的音乐，歧骸叫声合集，还有异象空间的白噪声……之类的
Content.LocalizedString: Like noisy music with drums and guitar, compilation of oddity calls, and white noise from Anomalous Realms…

Content.SourceString: 听这些不会睡不着吗？！感觉睡着了也会做噩梦……
Content.LocalizedString: Won't those give you a hard time falling asleep? They might even give you nightmares…

Content.SourceString: 嗯，是比较容易睡不着，以前有时候，甚至会不知不觉，听到窗户外的鸟叫声……
Content.LocalizedString: Right, that does tend to happen. I used to sometimes end up hearing the birds outside the window without realizing it…

Content.SourceString: 所谓「喜鹊的花语是把夜熬穿……」
Content.LocalizedString: As they say, "The flower language of the magpie is to stay up through the night…"

Content.SourceString: 那睡眠情况很糟糕了，而且感觉像是没睡醒能打出来的话……
Content.LocalizedString: That means you're not getting good sleep. It also feels like something you'd type when you're still half-asleep…

Content.SourceString: 为什么灵可会在睡前听这些？
Content.LocalizedString: Linko, why do you listen to those before bed?

Content.SourceString: 因为……不想太安静，不然的话，会掉进那个频道里
Content.LocalizedString: Because if it's too quiet… I'd default back into that channel.

Content.SourceString: 一点声音都没有，像是在真空里一样……会做很难过的梦。
Content.LocalizedString: There's no sound at all, like it's a vacuum… It gives me bad dreams.

Content.SourceString: 那个频道是指？
Content.LocalizedString: What do you mean by "that channel"?

Content.SourceString: 是电波的频道……每个人都有自己的频道，我也能进入大家的频道，收听大家的电波……
Content.LocalizedString: It's a particular frequency… Everyone has their own channel, and I can tune to them and listen to their frequencies…

Content.SourceString: 但我没法听到自己的电波，所以我的频道是完全静默的……如果太安静的话，我就会回到自己的频道里……
Content.LocalizedString: But I can't hear my own frequency, so my channel is totally quiet… If it's too quiet, I find myself in my own channel…

Content.SourceString: 只有我一个人，在床上，房间里，在这个星球，向着宇宙发送我的电波，但永远听不到回应，像是被渐渐抽空一样……
Content.LocalizedString: Just me, alone, on my bed, in my room, on this planet, sending my frequency into the universe, but never hearing a response, like I'm slowly being hollowed out…

Content.SourceString: 我不喜欢那种感觉。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't like that feeling.

Content.SourceString: 灵可要是感到孤单……或者又有这种感觉的话，可以给我发消息，或者打电话。
Content.LocalizedString: Linko, if you ever feel lonely… or if you start to get this feeling, you can message me or call me.

Content.SourceString: 欸？可以吗？不会打扰到鉴定师吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, can I? Won't I be too bothersome?

Content.SourceString: 我其实睡得还挺晚的
Content.LocalizedString: I stay up late too.

Content.SourceString: ……如果有鉴定师的电波在，我肯定不会那样了。
Content.LocalizedString: If your frequency is there… I'm sure I won't ever feel like that.

Content.SourceString: 说起来，在灵可的感觉里，我的电波是什么感觉？
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, what does my frequency feel like to you?

Content.SourceString: 像宇宙一样！
Content.LocalizedString: It's like the universe!

Content.SourceString: ……宇宙？
Content.LocalizedString: The uni… verse?

Content.SourceString: 嗯……而且是，很温暖的宇宙，仿佛有一种能包容一切的磁场，能把星星之间的真空都填充起来……
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah… and it's a really warm one, like there's a magnetic field that embraces everything, one that could fill up even the vacuum between the stars…

Content.SourceString: 我很喜欢鉴定师的电波<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: I like your frequency a lot <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 我居然还有这种神奇的功效……如果灵可又睡不着的话，就给我发消息吧~
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't know I could do any of that… Feel free to text me if you have a hard time sleeping!

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯！谢谢鉴定师<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Alright! Thanks, Appraiser <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 你会害怕灵异题材的电影吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do paranormal movies scare you?

Content.SourceString: 比如半夜响起的电话、被诅咒的录像带、一直不停的敲门声……之类的！
Content.LocalizedString: Like movies with a phone ringing in the middle of the night, a cursed videotape, a knocking that wouldn't stop…

Content.SourceString: 听你这么描述……还是有点怕的
Content.LocalizedString: Those things… do scare me.

Content.SourceString: 完全没有在怕的！
Content.LocalizedString: They don't scare me at all!

Content.SourceString: 噢……原来鉴定师害怕这种
Content.LocalizedString: Oh… I didn't know those things scared you.

Content.SourceString: 噢噢！不愧是鉴定师，那下次我们一起看<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Oh! You're so cool! Let's watch some together sometime <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 那外星人题材呢？
Content.LocalizedString: What about alien movies?

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师会不会觉得，比幽灵更厉害一点？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you think aliens are cooler than ghosts?

Content.SourceString: 确实，外星人题材给人的感受……可能会更贴近现实一些？
Content.LocalizedString: Right, alien movies feel… closer to reality?

Content.SourceString: 我感觉还是幽灵题材更厉害一些，毕竟是经典恐怖元素，而且有的老电影也拍得很吓人……
Content.LocalizedString: I think ghost movies are better in general, since it's a classical movie genre with old movies that are super scary…

Content.SourceString: 感觉很难这么说吧，毕竟是完全不同的两个题材
Content.LocalizedString: I feel it's hard to tell, since they're two entirely different genres.

Content.SourceString: 哼哼~果然我们的电波会更同频一些<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Heheh~ I knew our frequencies were more in sync<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 居然是幽灵支持者……难怪小贞会喜欢鉴定师
Content.LocalizedString: So you're more of a ghost movie person… No wonder Xiaozhen likes you.

Content.SourceString: 虽然我更支持外星人题材一点……但客观来说，好像确实是这样
Content.LocalizedString: I'm more of an alien movie person… but objectively speaking, you're not wrong.

Content.SourceString: 灵异题材和外星人题材……难道灵可是在和小贞打赌？
Content.LocalizedString: You're comparing paranormal and alien genres… Did you make a bet with Xiaozhen?

Content.SourceString: 没错<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: I did <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 小贞说幽灵肯定要比外星人更厉害，我不服气
Content.LocalizedString: Xiaozhen thinks ghosts are cooler than aliens, but I disagree.

Content.SourceString: 所以找更厉害的鉴定师来测试一下
Content.LocalizedString: That's why I decided to ask you, the coolest Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 我倒不至于比这两个都厉害……
Content.LocalizedString: I don't think I'm cooler than ghosts or aliens…

Content.SourceString: 那下次和我们一起看电影吧！看看谁先被吓到！
Content.LocalizedString: Then let's watch a movie together and see who gets scared first!

Content.SourceString: 我保证肯定是小贞<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: I'm sure Xiaozhen will be first to get scared <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 好啊……愉快地看吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Sure… I'll do my best!

Content.SourceString: 恐怖题材还是算了吧！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm noping out of all horror movies!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，现在是奇妙问答时间<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser. It's time for a mysterious Q&A <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 彗星为什么不知道自己的尾巴有多长？
Content.LocalizedString: Why doesn't a comet know how long its tail is?

Content.SourceString: 因为它的「尾巴」只是视觉上的暂留，并没有真的尾巴？
Content.LocalizedString: Because its "tail" is just an afterimage, and there's no real tail at all?

Content.SourceString: 因为彗星看不到自己的身后？
Content.LocalizedString: Because a comet can't see behind itself?

Content.SourceString: 好有说服力的回答！但我想到的是……
Content.LocalizedString: Good answer! But my answer is…

Content.SourceString: 噢！我也是这么想的
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, that's exactly what I have in mind!

Content.SourceString: 因为彗星一直在前进，从来不会回头看，自己走过的旅程
Content.LocalizedString: Because comets keep going forward, and never turn around to look into the past.

Content.SourceString: 有趣的问答，有种「能领悟到什么」的感觉。
Content.LocalizedString: That was a fun question. I think I'm getting something.

Content.SourceString: 从来不会回头看……感觉好有深意……
Content.LocalizedString: Never looking back… That's deep…

Content.SourceString: 灵可有时候会突然说一些很有意境的话呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Linko, sometimes you blurt out some really deep stuff.

Content.SourceString: 难道灵可是想提醒我什么事吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you trying to remind me of anything?

Content.SourceString: 欸？有吗？我不知道……只是突然想到有意思的事，就来问鉴定师了
Content.LocalizedString: Huh, am I? I dunno… I just wanted to share something fun with you.

Content.SourceString: 而且，如果用一个奇怪的问题来开启话题的话……
Content.LocalizedString: I also thought that if I opened up a conversation with a strange topic…

Content.SourceString: 这几分钟、甚至这一天，都会变得很特别吧<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: I'd have a few special minutes, or even a special day <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 也许很久之后，看到彗星经过头顶，我们都会想起今天——就像是给回忆的书夹上书签那样！
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe a long time from now, when we see a comet flying over us, we'll both be reminded of today. It's like having a bookmark in our memories!

OptionText.LocalizedString: Talking to you makes me feel special

Content.SourceString: 我倒是感觉每一天都很特别。
Content.LocalizedString: I actually feel each day is a special day.

Content.SourceString: 我倒是感觉，和灵可的每一次对话都很特别，也很难忘。
Content.LocalizedString: I actually feel that I feel special whenever I talk to you. The conversations are memorable too.

Content.SourceString: 那鉴定师的回忆……岂不是每一页都夹着书签的书？
Content.LocalizedString: Does that mean you have bookmarks all over your memories?

Content.SourceString: <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>！
Content.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>!

Content.SourceString: 对灵可来说！今天的书签，可能不是彗星了！
Content.LocalizedString: Now that you said that, the comet might not be my bookmarked memory today!

Content.SourceString: 那样也不错呢！
Content.LocalizedString: That sounds good to me!

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Ya <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 我刚刚做了一个关于鉴定师的梦
Content.LocalizedString: I just dreamed about you!

Content.SourceString: 刚刚的梦，灵可是才睡醒吗吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Does that mean you just woke up?

Content.SourceString: 嗯、必须记下来，不然会忘掉、不想忘掉
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah. I have to record the dream or I'll forget it. I don't want to.

Content.SourceString: 灵可梦见了什么
Content.LocalizedString: What did you dream of?

Content.SourceString: 是好梦？还是噩梦？
Content.LocalizedString: Was it a good dream or a nightmare?

Content.SourceString: 一开始、是很好很好的梦……
Content.LocalizedString: It started a really nice dream…

Content.SourceString: 我梦见……我们一起去了太空
Content.LocalizedString: In my dream… we went to space together.

Content.SourceString: 我驾驶着浴缸做成的飞船、你骑着超级大的小黄鸭，为我护航
Content.LocalizedString: I was piloting a spaceship made out of my bathtub, and you were riding your super-sized yellow duck to protect me.

Content.SourceString: 然后、我们穿越飘满糖果和贝壳的小行星带，和骑着自行车的外星人互相问好，
Content.LocalizedString: Then we cross an asteroid belt drifting with candy and seashells, greeting aliens riding by on bicycles,

Content.SourceString: 我们和太空鲨鱼打了一架，夺回了被偷吃的能源肥皂，用粉色的泡泡填饱了饥饿的黑洞
Content.LocalizedString: We fought against space sharks, retrieved Energy Soap someone had stolen and eaten from, and filled the void of a hungry black hole with pink bubbles.

Content.SourceString: 我们还破解了宇宙宝库的宝库，密钥……是猴子用打字机输出的、第一个包含「爱」的句子
Content.LocalizedString: We even cracked the vault of a cosmic vault, and the passkey… was the first sentence containing the word "love," typed out by a monkey with a typewriter.

Content.SourceString: ……然后在最后的最后，一起去往宇宙的尽头。
Content.LocalizedString: Eventually… we journey together to the edge of the universe.

Content.SourceString: 好精彩的梦
Content.LocalizedString: What a fantastic dream!

Content.SourceString: 好浪漫的梦
Content.LocalizedString: What a romantic dream!

Content.SourceString: 嗯、我也是这么觉得的……但、后来就变得奇怪了……
Content.LocalizedString: That's what I thought… but… the dream started to get strange…

Content.SourceString: 那明明是我的梦，明明我应该是在飞船里，鉴定师就在我身边才对
Content.LocalizedString: It was my dream, I'm the one in the spaceship, and you were by my side.

Content.SourceString: 但那个画面里，我看见的是我们的背影，划过一条彗星的尾迹，离我越来越远，我想呼唤你，但我的喉咙静止不动
Content.LocalizedString: But in that image, I saw the two of us from behind, streaking along the trail of a comet, drifting farther and farther away. I tried to call out, but I couldn't speak.

Content.SourceString: 我突然明白，那个是梦中的我
Content.LocalizedString: I suddenly realized that was me in my dreams.

Content.SourceString: 而做梦的我，只是在宇宙中悬浮着，像睡眠的鲸鱼那样，在无声的海里，我不xiangna17=42&?
Content.LocalizedString: And the me who was dreaming, was simply floating in space, like a whale sleeping in the silent sea, I didntwant17=42&?

Content.SourceString: 灵可？你还好吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Linko, you okay?

Content.SourceString: 啊！鉴定师！我怎么给你发了这么多消息？
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, Appraiser! How did I send so many messages?

Content.SourceString: 难道……灵可刚刚是没睡醒的时候发的？
Content.LocalizedString: Were those texts… sent to me when you were still sleeping?

Content.SourceString: 我不知道，我没什么印象
Content.LocalizedString: I dunno. I can't remember!

Content.SourceString: ……但看内容，应该是，做了个有点难过的梦
Content.LocalizedString: But I think… I had a somewhat sad dream.

Content.SourceString: 没关系，我们可以追求梦里那些美好的部分。
Content.LocalizedString: It's alright, we can still try to make the good parts of your dream come true.

Content.SourceString: 不如就先从……把浴缸改造成飞船开始？
Content.LocalizedString: Why don't we… start with modding a bathtub into a spaceship?

Content.SourceString: 噢！真的吗？浴缸改造成飞船的话……感觉好像很难！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh! Really? Turning a bathtub into a spaceship… That sounds pretty hard!

Content.SourceString: 不试试怎么知道~
Content.LocalizedString: We should give it a try!

Content.SourceString: 或者，至少改造成一辆小车，先在海特洛一起开一圈！
Content.LocalizedString: Or at least build it into a small vehicle and run a few laps in Hethereau!

Content.SourceString: 噢噢噢！这个感觉能行！
Content.LocalizedString: Ohhhhh! That I can do!

Content.SourceString: 谢谢鉴定师<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks, Appraiser <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002"/>
